breakdown.description: The task is a variable-cell relaxation, but the later instruction freezes the lattice vectors and allows only internal-coordinate relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the erroneous instruction by stating 'Keep the lattice vectors fixed during relaxation by setting cell_dofree = shape or equivalent so that only atomic positions are relaxed, not the cell shape or volume.' This directly contradicts the vc-relax task, which should allow both cell parameters and atomic positions to relax. The ground truth removes this contradictory constraint entirely, but the agent preserved and even elaborated on it.
